title: Dash passes through a wall tile
observed: A dash down from (1,1) after two steps right moved the player through a solid wall tile.
expected: Dash stops before the first solid tile (section 3).

title: Spikes at score 0 wrap the score to 65036 instead of clamping at 0
observed: Hitting spikes with score 0 shows score 65036 (wrapped negative value) instead of 0.
expected: Score never goes below 0; spikes subtract 500 but clamp at 0.

title: Restart level from pause leaves the game paused
observed: After pausing and clicking Restart level, the mode remains paused instead of running.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to start and the game is running again straight away.
